facts.fact: The NPP says the Ghana Rural Telephony and Digital Inclusion Project was launched in 2020 with a EUR155 million China EXIM Bank facility and an approved target of 2,016 sites for three to four million people, and calls for a status report on the remaining deployment and the proposed 4G upgrade.
facts.system: Ghana Rural Telephony and Digital Inclusion Project

facts.fact: The NPP says an earlier phase built and activated 430 rural sites in 2017 and 2018 connecting about 700,000 people, and 1,961 sites were constructed by the January 2025 handover.
facts.system: Ghana Rural Telephony and Digital Inclusion Project
